meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能驱动浏览器替你操作网页:打开网址、填表、截图等,并在多次脚本运行之间保留页面状态。它写小脚本一步步推进,每步跑完返回当前状态供判断下一步。
howto.when: 当你说出 “go to [url]”、“click on”、“take a screenshot” 等触发短语,或要求抓取网站数据、测试网页应用、自动化浏览器流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 https://example.com 并截图看一下页面
say.note: 脚本运行后返回标题、URL 并写出截图文件

say.text: 用我的 Chrome 扩展登录,去后台导出这个月的订单数据
say.note: 切换到扩展模式,在你的真实浏览器会话里操作

say.text: 用 getAISnapshot 看看这个页面有哪些可点的元素
say.note: 返回 YAML 无障碍树与元素 ref

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a browser to do web tasks: open URLs, fill forms, take screenshots, and more, keeping page state across script runs. It writes small scripts step by step and reports state after each run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for browser actions such as "go to [url]", "click on", "take a screenshot", or ask to scrape data, test a web app, or automate browser workflows.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot of the page.
say_en.note: Returns title, URL, and a screenshot file

say_en.text: Use my Chrome extension to log in and export this month's orders.
say_en.note: Runs on your real browser session

say_en.text: Use getAISnapshot to list the clickable elements on this page.
say_en.note: Returns a YAML accessibility tree with refs
